system_thesis_interpretation: V2a remains an identifiable development test only if the treatment is defined as trusted query-guided selection of public bytes, not hidden-target discovery: from one physically shared MEMORY_0 and THINK_0, compare sixteen matched RETURN_SLEEP calls under no feedback, own selection, and a precommitted distractor, then score immutable proposals offline. A selected view can legitimately carry the public route/effect evidence that the selector sought, but that mediation also makes the requested join recoverable from provider-visible bytes. Residual model contribution therefore requires a byte-only/no-model constructor ceiling over the exact selected views and C aliases; holding a selected view fixed while mutating hidden selector metadata proves boundary isolation but does not by itself separate model reasoning from deterministic selection and prompt structure.
graph_delta_interpretation: C aliases improve mechanical provenance but can also make the join nearly explicit: two visible records sharing Ck reveal connector equality even when the canonical connector is hidden. C assignment must be a one-to-one, call-seeded permutation independent of semantic rank, source order, arm, target, and own/distractor identity; repeated occurrences of one connector must share one alias, and the renderer must reject any canonical connector occurrence in all provider bytes. Parser-level semantic permutation invariance is not model-level order invariance, so alias labels, record order, endpoint order, shared-C patterns, and rendered positions remain shortcut features and must be reported. Offline relation normalization is causally downstream and acceptable only if raw text is immutable, but normalized closure is scorer-assisted. The score graph must expose byte-exact relation closure, normalized relation closure, and witness-bound normalized closure separately, including every unmatched or multiply mapped string, so normalization gain is never credited to recurrence. The current workflow does not yet close this graph: its freeze list omits inherited material modules/tests such as scientific_dream_adapter, provider/ledger/scheduler tests, capture_environment, and runtime_preflight, while its result analyst omits run_manifest, selector_traces, proposals, and baselines that the v2 workflow supplied.
loop_delta_interpretation: The EXACT/NEAR/OUT rule is directionally correct and outcome-independent, but not yet executable as 'exact': lexical overlap lacks token sequence/set/multiplicity and denominator definitions; endpoint frequency, provider position, bounded-memory rank, candidate-set construction, witness-kind vocabulary, and mechanical closure opportunity lack canonical formulas and tie/order rules. There is also a direct conflict: the spec classifies missing/non-finite comparisons OUT_OF_STRATUM and still runs them, while the change loop says preflight fails on missing/non-finite inputs. Distinguish a legitimate absent matched item (immutable OUT, run/report) from malformed or unavailable preflight computation (integrity failure, no provider call). Report EXACT and NEAR separately as well as combined; an all-OUT or zero-eligible result has no primary distractor estimand and cannot be rescued by the own/no-feedback result. The exact physical schedule is 802 recurrent DREAM plus 102 additional baseline DREAM calls, with all DREAM calls overridden to 256 tokens and 192-character canonical text; THINK has a maximum of 72 but its exact observed count must equal the predeclared per-life prefix through the first terminal, with every omitted suffix justified and no padding. Full-context and RAG are heterogeneous contextual competitors, not matched causal baselines: only the three RETURN_SLEEP arms share history, slot count, model, decoding, and opportunity. No recurrence-, memory-, or compute-advantage inference may use the 6-call full-context or 96-call RAG differences.
claim_delta_interpretation: At most, report a table over the six named aligned development lives: own-minus-no-feedback for every life, and own-minus-distractor as primary only within the immutable EXACT and NEAR strata, with OUT_OF_STRATUM distractor deltas visibly secondary. 'Changed' must mean the predeclared descriptive closure quantities, not a post hoc favorable threshold; direction, nulls, control wins, integrity failures, and stratum counts all remain visible. These three collision pairs are neither a random sample nor a heldout estimate. They cannot support reliability, general recurrence, autonomous discovery, model memory, architecture superiority, efficiency, scaling, behavioral utility, or a go-to-next-experiment claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The design must distinguish forbidden leakage from intended mediation. Selector tuple, target registry, query IDs, arm/stratum labels, ranking scores, normalization vocabulary, scorer output, private truth, and final task must be invariantly absent from prompt, config, parser inputs, memory, receipts, and later selection state. The public content selected because of the tuple is intentionally visible and is the treatment, so target recoverability from that content is not proof of a leak; it is a confound unless quantified by exact-view retrieval, shared-C compiler, canonical-string, and byte-only proposal controls. C aliases may expose connector equality but not canonical identity or the ledger. The normalization allowlist may be hash-locked before the run but must be unreadable by every cognition-time process and imported only after all eighteen MEMORY_1 barriers and independent artifact verification; its output can write only a separate score table and no control-flow value.
acceptance_test_interpretation: t_v2a_inherited_option_c_contract must enumerate and execute all fourteen exact v2 test IDs under an explicit four-row override map; matching three inherited hashes or invoking one aggregate test file is not sufficient. t_v2a_exact_exchangeability_classes must freeze canonical metric functions and fixtures for every exact/tolerance boundary, legitimate missing versus computation failure, immutable class, no replacement, separate EXACT/NEAR/OUT summaries, and zero eligible lives. t_v2a_connector_alias_boundary must prove one-to-one C binding, same-connector reuse, seeded permutation independent of semantic/order/arm fields, total canonical-ID removal, and parser semantic invariance, then audit provider-visible alias/order/shared-C target recoverability rather than assuming model invariance. t_v2a_maximal_dream_schema_fits_256 is satisfiable only after freezing a finite character/Unicode normalization and JSON-escaping grammar for every free-text field; enumerate operation-specific worst cases with the exact pinned tokenizer, count exact generated JSON bytes/tokens, and reject 193 characters, 257 tokens, truncation, or repair. t_v2a_offline_only_relation_normalization must scan imports and serialized artifacts as well as strings, delay allowlist loading until all MEMORY_1 commits, freeze an unambiguous mapping, preserve raw bytes, report byte-exact/normalized/witness-bound rows and unmatched strings, and prove score mutations cannot affect any cognition or route. t_v2a_schedule_baseline_artifact_closure must reconcile exactly 802 recurrent and 102 baseline provider calls, exact terminal-justified THINK cardinality <=72, 288 selector traces, eighteen MEMORY_1/scorer packets, per-call alias/parser/outcome linkage, all six exchangeability records, baseline compute, independent required inventory, and atomic exclusive terminal markers under omission/duplication/reorder/orphan attacks. It must also assert the v2a 256-token/192-character override on all 102 baseline DREAM calls and label unmatched full-context/RAG compute. t_v2a_immutable_dual_review_and_scope must freeze transitive imports/resources/tests plus exact v2a directive/spec/scope/change/workflow and inherited v2 spec/change/workflow hashes; reviewers must receive inspectable material bytes, not only a hash list, and ratification must bind the same closure and only the two v2a scope atoms. t_v2a_unconditional_human_stop must route success, null, all-OUT, control win, normalization anomaly, artifact failure, timeout, and reviewer failure to Rohin, with no automatic repair, retry, rerun, replication, heldout, LoRA, claim, external action, or spend change.
assumptions: The six logical lives are seeds 0, 1, and 2 with both collision twins, aligned skin only, and no heldout or additional-skin data are opened.
The own and matched-distractor targets are frozen before any provider call and remain fixed even when a life is OUT_OF_STRATUM.
The three RETURN_SLEEP arms use byte-identical shared-prefix and THINK_0 state and matched model/decoding/call envelopes; only trusted selected public views differ.
All 102 additional full-context/RAG calls are DREAM calls and therefore inherit the v2a 256-token output and 192-character canonical-text corrections.
Compiler, query-copy, deterministic retrieval, public-witness oracle, normalization, and C-alias join work are reported as non-model assistance, never recurrence reasoning.
No favorable count or delta constitutes authority to continue; every terminal state stops at Rohin.

ambiguities.question: What exact canonical candidate universe, witness-kind enumeration, token sequence/multiplicity and overlap denominator, endpoint-frequency pairing, one-based rendered provider position, memory-rank tie rule, and mechanical-closure algorithm define the frozen exchangeability row?
ambiguities.impact: Different reasonable implementations can change EXACT/NEAR/OUT labels and hence eligibility for the primary distractor contrast.

ambiguities.question: Does a missing/non-finite comparison create a runnable OUT_OF_STRATUM life as Correction 1 says, or fail preflight as the change loop stop condition says?
ambiguities.impact: The two dispositions change both the six-life schedule and whether an integrity defect can be silently recast as an ineligible but runnable comparison.

ambiguities.question: What finite Unicode normalization, allowed-character, control-character, quote/backslash escaping, and byte grammar defines a legal 192-character free-text field?
ambiguities.impact: Without it, infinitely many legal strings exist and some can exceed 256 Qwen tokens, so the maximal-schema acceptance test has no provable domain.

ambiguities.question: Is C assignment a seeded permutation independent of canonical connector order and arm identity, and do repeated route/effect occurrences of the same connector share exactly one C alias?
ambiguities.impact: A lexical or position-derived C index can reveal semantic rank or turn connector equality into an uncontrolled order shortcut.

ambiguities.question: Is the primary closure row byte-exact on verbatim relation text or allowlist-normalized, and what happens if one string maps to multiple labels or one proposal is unmatched?
ambiguities.impact: A normalized-only primary metric hides how much apparent closure was supplied by the offline scorer.

ambiguities.question: What predeclared descriptive quantity is meant by a go criterion, and are EXACT and NEAR pooled or always reported separately?
ambiguities.impact: With only six development lives, post hoc pooling or a favorable nonzero delta can create threshold language that resembles unsupported inference.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The exact v2 spec/change hashes are necessary but the current inheritance and workflow closure are not sufficient to prove that every inherited requirement executes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The old v2 workflow is context rather than explicit normative inheritance and is absent from the v2a freeze list; the aggregate inherited-contract test lacks a machine-readable fourteen-test mapping. The v2a freeze also omits material implementation/tests present in v2, and the v2a analyst loses run_manifest, selector traces, proposals, and baselines. A lock of named paths is not transitive closure, and a reviewer cannot inspect bytes supplied only as hashes.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, bind exact v2a directive/spec/scope/change/workflow plus exact inherited v2 spec/change/workflow and a four-correction override table; enumerate all inherited test IDs and evidence; freeze transitive imports/resources/tests; restore omitted review and result-analysis inputs; and require both reviewers to inspect identical material bytes.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed EXACT/NEAR/OUT rule is not yet an exact precommitted rule and contains a missing/non-finite disposition conflict.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Multiple metric domains, formulas, order conventions, and tie rules are undefined. The spec says missing/non-finite values become OUT and still run, while the change loop says preflight fails. These choices directly govern whether own-minus-distractor is primary evidence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze canonical metric algorithms and fixtures in the architecture bytes; distinguish legitimate absent required items (OUT and run) from malformed/unavailable computation (integrity stop); report strata separately; and define zero-eligible behavior before implementation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Removing the hidden tuple from provider bytes does not by itself identify model formation because selected public records and shared C aliases can mechanically reconstruct the desired join.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The selector intentionally enriches route/effect evidence, and equal C handles explicitly reveal connector equality. A deterministic parser/compiler can therefore create a closure-shaped proposal without latent model reasoning; metadata-invariance tests do not measure this mediated shortcut.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Run exact selected-view byte-only, shared-C join, canonical-string, query-copy, masked-content, wrong-connector, and deterministic-retrieval ceilings per arm and life; report their closure before model closure and attribute only a clearly labeled residual, while retaining query-guided allocation rather than discovery language.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A 192-character cap alone cannot prove that every legal maximal DREAM JSON operation fits 256 generated tokens.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Unicode, control characters, quotes, backslashes, and tokenizer fragmentation allow equal character counts to produce very different escaped byte and token lengths; 'every maximally sized legal operation' is not finite under the current prose.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze a bounded normalized character grammar for all free-text fields, enumerate operation-specific worst-case serialized JSON, and require exact tokenizer evidence <=256; otherwise reject the transition before GPU.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Calling allowlist-normalized equality 'raw exact closure' would misattribute scorer assistance to model recurrence.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The v2 raw metric already includes a normalized relation, while v2a moves that mapping decisively into the offline scorer. Isolation prevents online teaching but does not make the mapping a model output.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Predeclare separate verbatim byte-exact, normalized, and witness-bound normalized closure metrics; freeze an unambiguous allowlist before calls; report every unmatched string and normalization-only gain; and prohibit normalized-only language in the development claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The full-context and RAG conditions are informative ceilings or competitors, not fair matched baselines for an architecture or compute advantage.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: They differ materially in call count, context access, retrieval, accumulated state, and token opportunity. The v2a 256-token override also changes their inherited 128-token output ceilings unless made explicit.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Reserve causal attribution for the three matched RETURN_SLEEP arms, apply 256/192 consistently to all DREAM baselines, publish actual tokens/reads/calls/wall time and opportunity, and describe full-context/RAG comparisons only conditionally without recurrence, memory, efficiency, or superiority claims.

open_questions: Does Rohin require the exchangeability formulas, missing-value disposition, legal text grammar, and verbatim-versus-normalized primary metrics to be fixed in exact bytes before v2a can proceed?
Does Rohin require an executable fourteen-test inheritance map, transitive full-closure freeze, restored reviewer/analyst inputs, and ratification binding the exact v2a and inherited workflow bytes?

Does Rohin accept that any eventual result is only a six-life query-guided allocation observation after explicit compiler/normalizer accounting, with no discovery, recurrence-generalization, memory, efficiency, behavioral, or follow-up claim?
